headline: Missouri-St. Louis shuts out Ashland and Pittsburg State
dek: Missouri-St. Louis answered its season-opening defeat to Pittsburg State by keeping a clean sheet in the rematch, reaching eighteen wins against two losses. Having also beaten Ashland, Findlay, and Saginaw Valley State without conceding, the program has allowed thirteen goals while scoring 55 all season. Franklin Pierce is next.
